name: Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center (X-Humanoid)
summary: The Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center was set up in November 2023 as China's first provincial-level humanoid robot innovation center. It is a joint venture of Beijing Yizhuang Investment Holdings, UBTECH, Xiaomi and Beijing Jingcheng Machinery Electric, and develops the Tiangong humanoids.
